about: Runtime pieces and how they talk. The Lua mod runs inside LEGO Batman; SpideyLink.exe runs beside it, reads Spider-Man Remastered's files and plays its audio.

loads in game, F6/swing/launch cues reach SpideyLink (19:25)

rows.reads: the suited minifig (SceneCapture2D, 256 px, only the player's components)
rows.starts_when: 1 s after Spidey powers on, re-applied every second
rows.stops_when: F6 back to Batman (Batman's icon restored by asset path)
